title: Art Bronson's Bostonians in Denver
summary: After the Albuquerque band breaks up he follows the Gray brothers to Denver to join Art Bronson and His Bostonians.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: But after I went back with the band, they broke up. So the two Gray boys, Hunter and Henry, went to Denver. They knew the guy, Art Bronson, that had a band called the Bostonians....
I've heard of that band I guess because Lester Young played with them.

Yeah, he played with them. Right. So anyway, I told Henry, 'Well, you all get up there and sound that cat and see if he needs another trumpet player. If he does, I'd like to join him, because I ain't got no job.' You know, I'm way out here in Albuquerque and I don't know

too many people. I was supposed to have some kind of cousin out there or something, but I never did find him. But anyway, they went to Denver, and about a week later I got a ticket to come on up to Denver.

And that's when I went up to join Art Bronson and His Bostonians. I don't think nobody in there had ever been to Boston!, ha-ha, now that I think about it, you know. But they was a nice group, you know. Prez wasn't there. I wish he had've been; I'd love to have been there when he was there!
